extDescription.message: Always show the sender's email address next to their name in Outlook on the web. No hovering — spot spoofed senders at a glance.

readingDesc.message: Show next to the sender name in the reading pane

listDesc.message: Show next to the sender name in each inbox row

note.message: Click an address to copy it.

boldDesc.message: Make everything after @ bold to spot spoofed senders
